entries.title: deep
entries.load_when: Escalate to deep reasoning for hard problems — architecture and design decisions, cross-cutting refactors, bugs with unclear root cause, security-sensitive code, concurrency, or anything where a wrong first approach is expensive. Use it before writing code for such tasks. Do not use it for routine edits.

entries.title: ste100pp
entries.load_when: STE100++ writing mode. Applies controlled technical writing (inspired by ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English, not certified) to docs prose, procedures, help text, error messages, tool descriptions and agent prompts, in English or Polish. Use when the user asks for STE, STE100++, "plain technical English", "write it like a maintenance manual", "no fluff, no hedging", or wants text that a tired non-native reader cannot misread. Stays on until the user says "stop ste".

compatible.name: GitHub
compatible.description: Code hosting; README, CONTRIBUTING and SECURITY files, Actions, Pages, rulesets and releases follow its documented behaviour.

compatible.name: CLAUDE.md
compatible.description: Claude Code memory file; install.sh links the global rules as ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md.

compatible.description: Markdown index of a site for LLMs; generated from the same sources as the site.

compatible.description: Hosted agent memory with an MCP endpoint at https://www.usememory.com/api/mcp.
